name: model-gateway
description: Your ChatGPT/Codex, Grok, Kimi, Cursor, Muse, Vertex AI, and OpenCode Go models in Claude Code's /model picker. A local gateway sends every model claude-code-proxy serves (claude-gpt-*, claude-kimi-*, claude-muse-*, claude-gemini-*, claude-vertex/*, claude-glm-*, and the rest of its list) through that proxy, measured claude-grok-* models to Grok, and everything else to api.anthropic.com, so you switch between Claude and those models mid-session like any other model.
